# Switchback Sports

> > Family-owned ski and bike shop in Park City and Heber City, Utah, specializing in demo ski sales, equipment rentals, and professional service with brands like Armada, Atomic, Volkl, and Nordica.

Switchback Sports has been serving Utah's outdoor community since 2011, offering affordable access to premium ski and bike equipment through sales, rentals, consignment, and expert repair services. Known for demo skis at up to 70% off and fast turnaround on tuning and maintenance.

## Ski Equipment & Rentals

- [Park City Ski & Snowboard Rentals](https://switchbacksports.com/pages/park-city-ski-rentals): Park City ski rentals: Atomic, Armada, Volkl packages with price match
- [Shop Ski Gear & Equipment](https://switchbacksports.com/pages/ski-equipment): Demo/used skis, boots, apparel with savings up to 70% off
- [Silverado Lodge Ski Rentals at The Canyons](https://switchbacksports.com/pages/silverado-lodge-ski-rentals-canyons): Canyons Village ski rentals: Atomic, Armada, Volkl packages & delivery
- [All-Mountain Ski Collection](https://switchbacksports.com/collections/all/ski-all-mountain): All-mountain ski collection: bindings, boots, equipment catalog
- [Ski Service & Repair](https://switchbacksports.com/pages/ski-service-repair): Overnight ski tuning: hot wax, edge, stone grind, binding mount services
